mapper.select: SELECT plan_id, user_id, total_time_input, start_location, created_at, status FROM quick_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT qp.plan_id, qp.user_id, qp.total_time_input, qp.start_location, qp.created_at, qp.status, pi.plan_item_id, pi.plan_id, pi.place_id, pi.sequence_order, pi.transport_mode, pi.estimated_duration, h.place_name, h.overview, ST_Y(h.pos) AS latitude, ST_X(h.pos) AS longitude FROM quick_plan qp LEFT JOIN plan_item pi ON qp.plan_id = pi.plan_id LEFT JOIN hotplace h ON pi.place_id = h.place_id WHERE qp.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY pi.sequence_order

SELECT qp.plan_id, qp.user_id, qp.total_time_input, qp.start_location, qp.created_at, qp.status, pi.plan_item_id, pi.plan_id, pi.place_id, pi.sequence_order, pi.transport_mode, pi.estimated_duration, h.place_name, h.overview, ST_Y(h.pos) AS latitude, ST_X(h.pos) AS longitude FROM quick_plan qp LEFT JOIN plan_item pi ON qp.plan_id = pi.plan_id LEFT JOIN hotplace h ON pi.place_id = h.place_id WHERE qp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY qp.created_at DESC, pi.sequence_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quick_plan (user_id, total_time_input, start_location, created_at, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalTimeInput}, #{startLocation}, NOW(), #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler})
